column1: # reference/runtime-manifest.tsv — runtime manifest for crewboss box runtime (issue #62)
# Built from snapshot: _box-snapshot/cbnet/ (67 files, 2026-06-11, operator delivery #61)
#   CI verifies this manifest against repo files so it never goes stale silently.
#   Doctor on box compares deployed files against this manifest.
#   canonical       — repo has the file at repo_path with the snapshot sha256;
#                     CI gate: file must exist + sha must match
#   pending-backport — box has newer/different version OR file is box-only;
#   CANONICAL launcher = crewboss-launcher-gh.sh (GitHub-board live launcher, in use on box)
#   Launcher tests (reference/tests/launcher-*.test.sh) run against the LEGACY version until migration.
#   DO NOT DELETE the legacy file — tests depend on it.
#   run-gov-gatefire.sh — behavioral gate for charter→main; fires live agent against gate,
#   greps for 'crewboss BLOCK' marker in gate output to discriminate correct gate wiring;
#   pending-backport to reference/runtime/ after #65; #70 extends to *.css file scenarios.
#   Current proto/r8/ version lacks *.css coverage (finding: marker-grep-без-css).
